user.title: DMX Config UI
user.description: Adds the **DMX Config** panel to the sidebar. The panel writes the YAML configuration for [ha-artnet-led]({artnet_led_url}) – both 0.x (`artnet_led`) and 1.x (`dmx`).

data_description.include_file: File in the configuration directory that receives the generated `artnet_led` platforms, e.g. `dmx_config_ui.yaml`.

error.invalid_include_file: Use a relative path ending with .yaml or .yml inside the configuration directory (not configuration.yaml).

confirm.title: Restart Home Assistant
confirm.description: `{include_file}` was updated. ha-artnet-led only reads its configuration at startup, so Home Assistant needs to be restarted. The configuration is checked before restarting.

abort.config_invalid:
The configuration is invalid, restart aborted:

{error}

confirm.title: Include the generated file
confirm.description:
`{include_file}` is not referenced in `configuration.yaml`, so Home Assistant will not load it. Submit to append the following line:

`{include_line}`

confirm.title: Include the generated file
confirm.description:
`{include_file}` is not referenced in `configuration.yaml`, so Home Assistant will not load it. Submit to set the `dmx:` key to:

`{include_line}`

An existing `dmx:` block is replaced; the previous `configuration.yaml` is saved as `{backup_file}` first ("-" = no block present).
